testu01.note: The adapter passes the exact requested nb, rejects nb larger than the finite file, and never extends the input. TestU01 may internally use the largest whole 32-bit prefix and rewinds the same file between distinct tests.

testu01.reason: an audited finite-file adapter is selected

execution.reader_padding_reason: official binary reader requires four-byte reads; tp.n stops conversion after the exact original bit count

eligibility.reason: only one physical sequence exists for this configuration; the final-report uniformity/proportion columns cannot support a validation claim
eligibility.fft_note: SP 800-22 Rev. 1a section 2.6.7 recommends n >= 1,000 bits for the spectral test; all four streams meet it

eligibility.reason: PractRand accepts whole 1KiB TestBlocks; the result covers the largest exact prefix and the unmodified tail is not silently padded or repeated
eligibility.short_run_note: approximately 127-136 KiB is only a short diagnostic run, not evidence of long-stream randomness

eligibility.reason: TestU01 file batteries consume whole 32-bit words; the exact requested nb was passed, and the remaining tail was neither padded nor repeated
eligibility.reuse_scope: each statistical test starts from the same finite sequence; this does not extend a test beyond the requested bit count
